<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#C393FF"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#E42A6C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#200E32" flood-opacity=".14"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="25" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="20" x2="315" y2="16" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="20" x2="320" y2="13" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="20" x2="325" y2="10" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="342" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="13" x2="345" y2="19" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="357" y="11" width="23" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359.5" y="13.5" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#200745"/>
    <rect x="380.5" y="14.5" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#200745"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top navigation -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,62 23,70 31,78" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="70" x2="42" y2="70" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="77" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#200745">Add payment method</text>
    <circle cx="358" cy="70" r="16" fill="#F5F2FA"/>
    <line x1="352" y1="70" x2="364" y2="70" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="64" x2="358" y2="76" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- card preview shadow and card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="104" width="342" height="166" rx="20" fill="#200E32" opacity=".08"/>
    <rect x="24" y="100" width="342" height="166" rx="20" fill="url(#cardGradient)"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <text x="48" y="132" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82">PAYMENT CARD</text>
    <circle cx="318" cy="135" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".78"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="135" r="17" fill="#FFDD72" opacity=".88"/>
    <text x="48" y="196" font-family="Inter" font-size="21" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF">••••  ••••  ••••  4242</text>
    <text x="48" y="231" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".78">CARDHOLDER</text>
    <text x="48" y="249" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">ALEX MORGAN</text>
    <text x="298" y="231" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".78">EXPIRES</text>
    <text x="298" y="249" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">08/28</text>
  </g>

  <!-- form section -->
  <text x="24" y="304" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Enter your card details securely below.</text>

  <g>
    <text x="24" y="342" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Card number</text>
    <rect x="24" y="350" width="342" height="52" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="42" y="382" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">4242 4242 4242 4242</text>
    <rect x="318" y="365" width="28" height="20" rx="4" fill="#F5F2FA"/>
    <circle cx="329" cy="375" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#A06AF9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="337" cy="375" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FBA3FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="24" y="419" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">16-digit number on the front of your card</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <text x="24" y="455" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Expiration date</text>
    <rect x="24" y="463" width="160" height="52" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="42" y="495" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">MM / YY</text>
    <rect x="206" y="463" width="160" height="52" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="206" y="455" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">CVV</text>
    <text x="224" y="495" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">123</text>
    <circle cx="342" cy="489" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="342" y="493" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#5E6272">?</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <text x="24" y="558" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Name on card</text>
    <rect x="24" y="566" width="342" height="52" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="42" y="598" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5E6272">Alex Morgan</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="642" width="18" height="18" rx="4" fill="#200745"/>
    <polyline points="28,651 32,655 39,647" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="656" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#434343">Save this card for future payments</text>
    <circle cx="344" cy="650" r="10" fill="#F5F2FA"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="650" x2="348" y2="650" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="646" x2="344" y2="654" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- save button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="686" width="342" height="52" rx="14" fill="#200745"/>
    <text x="195" y="719" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Save payment method</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="390" y2="764" stroke="#E7E7E7" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,785 49,776 59,785 59,798 39,798" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <polyline points="35,785 49,773 63,785" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="49" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="115" y="778" width="22" height="18" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="120,796 124,796 120,801" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="784" x2="132" y2="784" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="789" x2="130" y2="789" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="126" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Activity</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="216" cy="786" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="216" y1="779" x2="216" y2="793" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="209" y1="786" x2="223" y2="786" stroke="#200745" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="216" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#200745">Payments</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="306" cy="782" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="306" cy="798" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="306" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="161" y="835" width="68" height="4" rx="2" fill="#200745"/>
</svg>
